audit.why: 52.96% over 574 games, diff TRICKY at 7.5/10, carry threat 7/10. The packet flags the chart as contradicting the win rate, but the win rate is carried by Stand United's map value rather than lane dominance, so a chart that gives Kennen the local windows is not actually wrong.
audit.corrected: Ratings kept; the chart re-sided to match the mirror instead of forcing Shen rows to justify the win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows disagreed with the already-audited mirror: Level 1 read Kennen (mirror Skill), Level 2 read Skill (mirror Kennen), Level 3 read Shen (mirror Kennen), Levels 4-5 read Shen (mirror Skill), First item read Shen (mirror Skill).
audit.why: The mirror (kennen__shen) re-sided its rows in matched pairs to Skill / Kennen / Kennen / Skill / Kennen / Skill / Shen. Level 2-3 is genuinely Kennen's: Mark of the Storm needs three applications and Q, auto and Lightning Rush give him exactly three, before Shen has a taunt worth the 18s. Level 6 already agreed (Kennen) and 2+ items already agreed (Shen).
audit.corrected: All five rows flipped in matched full/content pairs with ratings moved to suit, and phases[1].why, phases[2].why, phases[3].why, phases[5].why and whys[3] rewritten so the captions argue the new sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields tell the player Spirit's Refuge blocks Kennen's Thundering Shuriken (Q), his passive mark procs, or Slicing Maelstrom: wants.you[0], early ('intercept his Q projectiles with W'), mid ('use W to block his Q poke'), late ('blocks the on-hit stun procs'), spikes[3] ('absorb it with your Spirit's Refuge'). Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only. Q, W-active and R all land straight through it.
audit.why: This is the single mechanic the page repeats most, and it is inverted. A Shen who stands in his own W zone believing it eats shuriken poke simply takes the poke for free. The mirror audit already states the correct rule on Kennen's page.
audit.corrected: Spirit's Refuge restated as basic-attacks-only in all five fields, with the W kept for his auto weave and W-active on-hit procs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page states that a Mark of the Storm stun cancels Stand United.
audit.why: Stand United is a channel (kit flag: 'interruptible — any CC cancels it') and Kennen's entire kit is built to land a three-mark stun. His R is 550 range on a flat 120s. This is the highest-value interaction in the matchup and the page sells Stand United as the win condition without mentioning it can be taken off him.
audit.corrected: Added to late and spikes[3].text with the real numbers (120s flat R, 550 range).

audit.whatIsWrong: Lightning Rush is tracked as 'the' cooldown everywhere with no number.
audit.why: It is 10/9/8/7/6 — a 10s escape at rank 1 against an 18s Shadow Dash, which is why levels 4-5 are even rather than Shen's.
audit.corrected: Real numbers added to whys[3] and phases[3].why.

edits.before: At Level 1 this is a coin flip — Kennen's auto-attack range (550) and Q poke let him contest the wave freely, and you have no taunt to punish him yet. Park your spirit blade in the minion wave to intercept his Q projectiles with W when he tries to poke, but do not walk up into auto range without it. Your goal at Level 1 is a clean CS score and zero mark stacks on you. At Level 2 he gets W (Electrical Surge), which passively marks you with every Q hit and on-hit auto; he wants three stacks for the stun proc. Respect that pattern — once he hits two marks back off until they decay, then re-engage on your terms with E.
edits.after: At Level 1 this is a coin flip — Kennen's auto-attack range (550) and Q poke let him contest the wave freely, and you have no taunt to punish him yet. Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks only, so it does nothing against Thundering Shuriken (Q) — dodge the shuriken with movement and save W for his auto weave. Your goal at Level 1 is a clean CS score and zero mark stacks on you. At Level 2 he gets W (Electrical Surge), which passively marks you with every Q hit and on-hit auto; he wants three stacks for the stun proc. edits.before: Levels 3-5 are Kennen's best local-lane window. His Q-W poke chips your HP pool while Lightning Rush gives him an escape you cannot reliably catch, and at Level 3 he can stun-combo you before your Ki Barrier absorbs enough damage. Play this phase to farm, not to win — keep the wave slightly on your side, use W to block his Q poke (position the spirit blade on the path between you), and only commit your E when his Lightning Rush is visibly on cooldown. If he burns Rush to dodge your taunt, back off and reset; never chase a Kennen through the fog. Level 6 is your recalibration point: Stand United makes you globally dangerous regardless of this lane's score, so the moment R is available, stop trading and look for a down-lane ally to bail out.

edits.before: By the two-item mark the matchup is a genuine skill split — Kennen's Zhonya's into R stun burst can still kill you if you mistime your W, but your Sunfire/Heartsteel bulk means he cannot one-rotation you without burning his full cooldown rotation plus the hourglass. The lane win condition shifts entirely to the map: you want to always have Stand United off cooldown entering a dragon or baron setup, so Kennen cannot simply press R and win the fight for free. If Kennen channels his R, immediately drop W in the cluster — your Spirit's Refuge blocks the on-hit stun procs from his passive marks, blunting the teamfight entirely. In a split-push scenario you will shove faster than he can poke you out at 2+ items; abuse that to draw his teleport and open the map for your team.
edits.after: By the two-item mark the matchup is a genuine skill split — Kennen's Zhonya's into R stun burst can still kill you if you mistime your W, but your Sunfire/Heartsteel bulk means he cannot one-rotation you without burning his full cooldown rotation plus the hourglass. Stand United is a channel and a Mark of the Storm stun cancels it, so start R out of his 550 R range or after Slicing Maelstrom is spent — 120s flat. edits.before: Kennen's R Slicing Maelstrom stuns the entire team, so never group on a wall or chokepoint — spread your team and absorb it with your Spirit's Refuge W before he flashes in.
edits.after: Kennen's R Slicing Maelstrom stuns the entire team on a flat 120s, so never group on a chokepoint — W cannot block it, and its stun cancels Stand United mid-channel.
